text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! Just as expected, you're super 
good at it.
choice_data_list:
I'm going to give it all to Buena as a 
present!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Since we have it, can I decorate the 
Trainer's Room with it?"
choice_data_list:
Are you sure you don't want to use your 
own room?

Are you sure it's okay not to use your own 
room?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Well, you went out of your way to win it 
for me. I wanted you to dote on it a 
little, too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If it's in the trainer's office, I can 
watch it too. What do you think?
choice_data_list: I see... If that's the case...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! There's a lot of them... Can I put 
some on the shelf... and on the desk too?
choice_data_list:
The room's going to be overflowing with 
Paka Puchi.

The room's going to be overflowing with 
Paka Puchi, huh.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't you like it? Because... I want 
you to remember today.
